judge.rationale: The candidate only wrote the definition of done, the spec update, and the failing acceptance test, completely omitting the actual implementation in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because `chatOrchestrator.ts` was never modified, the `error instanceof Error` gate remains in place and the newly added test will fail. Additionally, the candidate failed to update `CHANGELOG.md` as required by the acceptance criteria and added an extraneous `.lore/dod.md` file alongside a separate test file rather than extending `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`.
